clips.title: Don't Build Agents, Build Skills Instead – Barry Zhang & Mahesh Murag, Anthropic
clips.why: Anthropic's skills team describes how an agent is built from a general loop plus many small skills, some about a domain and some about a way of working.
look: Skills grow in two directions: knowledge of a domain and ways of doing a kind of work.
One agent loads only the skills a task needs, from a large library.
clips.after: Our map and method split is the same idea: one codebase skill and one task skill per task, from a catalog every engineer and agent shares.

clips.title: The Claude Code Skill Creator Just Got Evals & Benchmarking
clips.why: A short look at trigger optimization: testing whether a skill fires on the requests it is for, and not on the others.
look: The trigger is tested with requests that should and should not load the skill.
The description is changed until both kinds of request behave.
clips.after: Our stays-quiet case is the should-not half of that test, written as a case.yaml that runs on every pull request.

practice.q: Limit fe-codebase to sessions that work with frontend files.
practice.hint: The folder name, then two stars for everything inside it.
practice.why: The glob matches every file under frontend/, so the skill is offered once the session reads or edits one of them.

practice.q: fix-flaky-test explains how to reproduce a flaky test with repeats and random order, the usual causes, and why retries are not a fix. What kind of skill is it?

options.text: A codebase skill, because it lives in be-guild
options.why: Where a skill is stored does not decide its kind. What it teaches does.

options.text: A task skill: a method for one kind of work
options.why: It teaches how to do the work. The map of the code comes from be-codebase or fe-codebase alongside it.
verify is about proving any change. Hunting a flake is its own method.

items: Triage: is it a duplicate, who owns it, how bad is it
Reproduce it first, with a failing test or a recorded run on seed data
Name the root cause with file and line
Make the smallest safe fix, so the reproduction passes
Look for the same pattern nearby and list it in the pull request
practice.why: The reproduction comes before the fix, so the same test that failed can prove the fix.

practice.q: A positive case for fe-codebase says only: "Plan how to add an empty state to the projects table." Its skill-fired grader fails in most runs. What is the most likely reason?

options.text: The prompt never makes the agent open a frontend file, so the path-scoped skill was not offered
options.why: Name the file and ask the agent to read it, and the skill becomes available.
With paths set, a better description does not help before a matching file is touched.

options.text: The judge model is too small
options.why: tool_used is a free grader with no judge. It just reports that the skill did not load.
